actual.titulo: DP World Tour Golf • Omega European Masters, First Round
actual.descripcion: Omega European Masters, First Round | The 2026 Omega European Masters Individual Stroke Play Round 1 begins at Crans-sur-Sierre Golf Club. 156 golfers take to the course across morning and afternoon tee times. A purse of $3,750,000 and 5,000 Race to Dubai points are up for grabs.
